facts.text: Nobody takes this club from us, Quick. Now sit, the steaks are coming out.
facts.why: Sugar Ray never says this. A real line from him is about leaving Harlem and how there is no place like it.
facts.fix: But there's no place like Harlem.

fix_note.text: But there's no place like Harlem.

facts.text: Serve the drinks when the craps tables open at Club Sugar Ray.
facts.why: The plot has the club running gambling and dancing out front. No scene shows the craps tables opening, so the cue is rewritten to the night's gambling and dancing.
facts.fix: Serve the drinks when the gambling and dancing start up at Club Sugar Ray.
